text: Senior journalist Anwar Iqbal says Islamabad MOU marks the start of formal Iran-US negotiations. Key issues include reopening the Strait of Hormuz, resolving nuclear concerns, addressing Lebanon’s security situation, and reaching agreements with support from mediator Pakistan.
translated_text: 资深记者安瓦尔·伊克巴尔表示，伊斯兰堡谅解备忘录标志着伊朗与美国正式谈判的开始。关键问题包括重新开放霍尔木兹海峡、解决核问题、解决黎巴嫩的安全局势以及在调解人巴基斯坦的支持下达成协议。

text: US President Donald Trump says in a Truth Social post that there will be no tolls in the Strait of Hormuz during the 60-day ceasefire period, and no tolls afterward unless imposed by the United States of America, should the deal not be completed, for services rendered as the
translated_text: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在《真相社会》帖子中表示，在 60 天停火期间，霍尔木兹海峡将不会收取通行费，停火后也不会收取通行费，除非协议未能完成，美利​​坚合众国强制实施。

text: Pakistan played a key role in bringing both sides to the table and facilitating the signing of the memorandum of understanding. With that phase completed, attention now shifts to the technical aspects of the agreement, to be discussed at Burgenstock Resort in Switzerland.
translated_text: 巴基斯坦在促使双方坐到谈判桌并推动签署谅解备忘录方面发挥了关键作用。随着该阶段的完成，注意力现在转移到协议的技术方面，并将在瑞士布尔根施托克度假村进行讨论。
